readings.Aries: The version of yourself you're fighting to protect is not the version you need to become. The connection you almost didn't make is the one that matters.
readings.Taurus: Something is being offered. Your instinct is to evaluate before accepting. The evaluation is taking too long. The question matters more than the answer right now.
readings.Gemini: There is a version of the conversation you keep starting that would actually end it. Try that one. The answer that feels too obvious is probably the actual answer.
readings.Cancer: The relationship that costs you the most emotionally might be where you're needed most. Or not. Check. Something small done consistently has more effect than something large done once.
readings.Leo: Your instinct for the dramatic is usually right. In this case it's obscuring what's actually simple. Saying less will move this further than saying more.
readings.Virgo: Something you're maintaining out of habit is no longer serving the purpose it was built for. The answer that feels too obvious is probably the actual answer.
readings.Libra: The thing you've been putting off deciding has already been decided by your inaction. Notice this. The answer that feels too obvious is probably the actual answer.
readings.Scorpio: The transformation you're in the middle of is not comfortable. It's not supposed to be. One conversation today matters more than the rest combined.
readings.Sagittarius: You are more attached to the journey than to the destination, which is beautiful and occasionally inconvenient. Small, deliberate, and patient — that's the mode today.
readings.Capricorn: The foundation you've laid is solid. Build something on it today that's for you alone. The connection you almost didn't make is the one that matters.
readings.Aquarius: Someone is trying to reach you through the systems you've put up. Let them. The resistance you feel is pointing at something worth examining.
readings.Pisces: You've been trying to make sense of something that can only be felt, not understood. Feel it. This situation responds well to direct engagement.

sky_notes: Mercury appears retrograde today. Earth isn't overtaking Mercury — Mercury is lapping us on the inside track, so it appears to drift backwards against the stars. Your western blot is unaffected.
Venus appears retrograde today. Venus is passing between us and the Sun, so it appears to slide backwards for ~6 weeks. Gravity on your bench is unchanged.
Saturn appears retrograde today. Earth is overtaking Saturn — an apparent backwards loop that happens every year for ~4.5 months. Plan your timecourse accordingly (or don't).
Uranus appears retrograde today. Uranus spends ~5 months of every year appearing to go backwards because Earth laps it. It's tilted 98°, so it's used to looking odd.
Neptune appears retrograde today. Neptune appears retrograde ~5 months a year as Earth laps it. Light from Neptune takes ~4 hours to reach you, so this news is already old.
New Moon: the Moon is roughly between Earth and the Sun, so its sunlit side faces away from us. Ideal conditions for astronomers; irrelevant to your cells.
Mars and Jupiter are within 1.9° of each other in the sky — a line-of-sight coincidence; in reality they are hundreds of millions of km apart.

calculation_methods: Planetary longitudes: geocentric, from JPL Keplerian elements (Standish, valid 1800–2050) + Meeus ch.25/47 for Sun & Moon; checked against PyEphem to within 0.5°
Positions are for ~midday Sydney time on the stated date (tropical zodiac, equinox of date)
Retrograde: computed from direction of longitude change vs previous day
Aspects: angular separation with standard orbs (conjunction 8°, sextile 6°, square/trine/opposition 8°, quincunx 3°)
Compatibility: element harmony base score + modality adjustment + date-seeded variance
Daily readings: deterministic date-seed (PRNG) selects from 60-entry per-sign pools + 30-entry suffix pool; 1,800 combinations per sign
